title: Audio Motion Flags V1.5
description: Detected motion patterns of Audio Objects within an OSD-described space: classification of motion behaviour, confidence, optional motion vector and temporal window for each Audio Object.

MInstanceID.description: ID of the Virtual Space the Audio Scene refers to.

AudioMotionFlagsID.description: Identifier of this Audio Motion Flags entry.

AudioMotionFlagsData.description: List of Audio Motion entries, one per Audio Object.

AudioObjectID.description: Unique identifier of the Audio Object.

MotionConfidence.description: Confidence level associated with the motion classification.

MotionVector.description: Optional 3D vector (dx, dy, dz) expressing relative motion in user-relative coordinates.

TemporalWindow.description: Temporal interval over which the motion classification was computed.

Trace.description: AIF V3.0 trace information identifying provenance and timestamp.
